description_en: Changes the specifications of coordinator node resources for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
name: ModifyMasterSpec

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The specifications of coordinator node resources. Valid values:

2 CU
4 CU
8 CU
16 CU
32 CU

You are charged for coordinator node resources of more than 8 compute units (CUs)
parameters.help_zh:
Master资源，取值如下： 
2 CU 
4 CU 
8 CU 
16 CU 
32 CU 
8CU以上的master资源会产生费用
parameters.name: master_cu

parameters.help_en:
This parameter must be specified if you want to change coordinator nodes to AI coordinator nodes.
You cannot specify the MasterAISpec and MasterCU parameters at the same time.
You can change coordinator nodes to AI coordinator nodes only in specific regions and zones.
Only AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances of Basic Edition support AI coordinator nodes.
You can view the valid values of this parameter on the configuration change page of coordinator nodes
parameters.help_zh:
如果您需要将Master节点变更为MasterAI节点，请指定该参数。

该参数与MasterCU不能同时指定。
仅部分地域和可用区均支持将Master节点变更为MasterAI节点。
仅AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版的基础版实例支持MasterAI节点。
您可以在Master节点变配的售卖页面上查询该参数的所有可能取值
parameters.name: master_ai_spec

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The returned message.

This parameter is returned only if the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。

只会在API执行失败时返回该参数

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

false
true
Status.description_zh:
API执行状态，取值如下：
false：执行失败。
true：执行成功
